title: Contract Pricing Agreement Final Rebate Check Amount: Rebate Administration Note
content:
**Final check amount — rebate administration note (Contract Pricing Agreement)**

*Agreement in view.* The agreement's status is terminated after the customer's early termination, its tier's rebate payout methods include check, and the customer asks for the unpaid rebate to be paid by check.

*Unpaid rebate balance.* The final check pays the agreement's unpaid rebate balance, which is the rebate accrued on the agreement less every payout and every reversal on its rebate ledger, across all rebate periods.

*Floor and rounding.* The final check is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

*Holdbacks.* The holdbacks set for the final check are added together and subtracted once from the unpaid rebate balance before that floor, that rounding and that minimum are applied.

*Minimum.* A final check below the tier's minimum rebate payout (the tier's figure in the rebate program terms) is not issued and the balance carries forward. The comparison is made on the check as rounded to the cent.

*Period of the payout line.* The payout line of a final check is recorded against the agreement's latest accrued rebate period.

| Hypothetical ledger | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rebate accrued, all periods | 6000.00 |
| Payouts | 1000.00 |
| Reversals | 500.00 |
| Unpaid rebate balance | 6000.00 less 1000.00 less 500.00, which is 4500.00 |
| Final check | 4500.00 |

Minimum, boundary (hypothetical minimum of 250.00): a check of 250.00 is issued; a check of 249.99 is not issued and the balance carries forward.
